messages.text: Dutch tie record Nations League win as Reijnders leads rout of Greece

metadata.summary: The Netherlands routed Greece 7-0 on Friday to tie the record for the largest Nations League victory and stay unbeaten under new coach Xavi.
metadata.content: Netherlands 7-0 Greece (Nov 13, 2026) Game Analysis - ESPN Skip to main content Skip to navigation UEFA Nations League, Group A2 Netherlands Netherlands NED 3-2-0 , 11 PTS 7 3-2-0 , 11 PTS FT Greece Greece GRE 2-2-1 , 8 PTS 0 2-2-1 , 8 PTS Crysencio Summerville - 6' Tijjani Reijnders - 12', 18', 33' Jurriën Timber - 40', 59' Donyell Malen - 61' Netherlands v Greece By ESPN News Services Nov 13, 2027, 05:08 pm Facebook Facebook Messenger Twitter Email The Netherlands routed Greece 7-0 on Friday to tie the record for the largest Nations League victory and stay unbeaten under new coach Xavi. Tijjani Reijnders scored a hat trick and Jurriën Timber had two goals in a rampant win for the Netherlands. Beaming and holding up three fingers, Reijnders celebrated a hat trick which came off a series of slick team moves to tear apart the Greek defense in Amsterdam. It was the first time Greece had conceded seven goals in a match since May 1989. Tijjani Reijnders celebrates after completing his hat trick in the Netherlands' win over Greece. ANP via Getty Images Crysencio Summerville got the Netherlands started with a sixth-minute opener before Reijnders scored three in the space of 21 minutes, Timber added two more and Donyell Malen a seventh. Germany beat Serbia 3-1 on Friday to remain three points behind Group A2 leader the Netherlands before they play on Monday in Berlin. England have hit back at Eddie Jones' claim they could be vulnerable to an upset by Japan on Saturday because they have one eye on their upcoming game with New Zealand. Pochettino has been appointed as Michael Carrick's replacement at Old Trafford having signed a deal until the summer of 2029. It comes mere months after extending his stay with the USMNT until the 2030 World Cup. Viddal Riley will put himself on a path to a cruiserweight world title shot, if he can defend the European championship against Seydi Coupe on Saturday. Only 14 fights into his pro career, Riley is already rated as the IBF's No. 2 contender for their world championship. The Londoner wants to showcase himself as a world champion in waiting against Coupe. "I think I'm the most well-rounded cruiserweight in the world," Riley told Sky Sports . "I think we've trained for that because we want to cover every aspect of the game. We don't want to be lacking any area when it comes to movement, speed, IQ. All these things, I have them." metadata.content: Cheltenham: Jonbon records Shloer Chase hat-trick for Nicky Henderson | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cheltenham: Jonbon records Shloer Chase hat-trick for Nicky Henderson The evergreen Jonbon continued his record of never finishing outside the first two places when seeing off Mighty Bandit to land a third Shloer Chase crown at Cheltenham for Nicky Henderson and JP McManus Friday 13 November 2026 16:04, UK Image: Jonbon - a three-time winner of the Shloer Chase Harry Cobden made his first ride on Jonbon in public a successful one as the odds-on favourite landed a third Shloer Chase in gritty fashion at Cheltenham. Never out of the first two in 29 races, Nicky Henderson's charge is approaching veteran status at the age of 10 and was winning for the 21st time in his stellar career. His task was made easier with the late withdrawal of Gidleigh Park, but Mighty Bandit kept him honest after the last, with the 1-2 favourite pulling away again towards to line to win by two and a quarter lengths. Cobden said: "I'm so fortunate to be in this position riding all of these great horses and there's so many in the camp to look forward to, you do have to pinch yourself a little bit. "I was really looking forward to it and pressure is just something you put on yourself isn't it. There was no point having a sleepless night over a Shloer Chase though as what would I be like in March!" He went on: "I really enjoyed that. metadata.summary: Ahead of the start of Cheltenham's November meeting, the Weekend Winners panel offered their top tips for a potentially informative Saturday at Prestbury Park.
metadata.content: Cheltenham tips: July Flower fancied for Handicap gold at Prestbury Park | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Cheltenham tips: July Flower fancied for Handicap gold at Prestbury Park Ahead of a huge Saturday of action at Cheltenham, Kate Tracey, Sam Boswell and Declan Rix reconvene to discuss the best betting angles for the November meeting; Watch the full episode of Weekend Winners on the At The Races YouTube channel. Friday 13 November 2026 10:44, UK Image: Watch Weekend Winners on the At The Races YouTube channel Ahead of the start of Cheltenham's November meeting, the Weekend Winners panel offered their top tips for a potentially informative Saturday at Prestbury Park. The panel of Kate Tracey, Declan Rix and Sam Boswell paid particular attention to the feature Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase, which sees Meetmebythesea head the market for Ben Pauling. Blueking d'Oroux will be looking to rediscover the winning thread having finished second the last twice, whilst Cheltenham Festival hero Madara also represents the formidable Skelton operation. Quebecois and July Flower could also have a say, alongside the likes of Norn Iron, O'Moore Park and Zurich. Declan Rix... "A mare won this last year, and I am hoping the girls can do the same here with July Flower . I feel like we haven't seen the best of her yet but she won at this meeting last year when winning the Arkle Trial. She's a lovely, big mare and maybe we could see the best of her this season.
